comment: Independent debug-mode Priestess raised to experience level 30 with #levelchange, then #quit. The final conduct and achievements window is an NHW_MENU text window at offx 38 whose --More-- row is the first status row, so wintty.c erase_menu_or_text() calls docorner(offx, maxrow + 1, 0) with ymax past WIN_STATUS->offy: cl_end() clears the status suffix from offx and docorner() then sets disp.botlx and calls bot(), which redraws both status rows before the dungeon-overview prompt.
